name: Parity generator / checker
summary: Computes a parity indication from the defined digital input word.
description: Computes a parity indication from the defined digital input word.

On a schematic, identify the data width, odd/even convention and cascade mapping and trace the parity output and check/alarm interface. Keep the component tag and signal/reference names consistent across the control drawing, terminal schedule and device documentation.
A parity check detects a defined class of bit errors; it is not a complete CRC, data-integrity or safety protocol.
